headline: Context Mode slashes token costs by preventing bloat, not just compressing it
summary: Context Mode reduces token usage by 98% for AI agents. Prevents context bloat before it starts.
details: Context Mode is an open-source MCP-based context management system. It doesn't compress tokens after they bloat your context — it prevents bloat before it starts.
Tested with 315KB Playwright snapshots, reduced to 5.4KB, a 98% reduction. This helps AI agent developers avoid evaporating their $200/month token budget.
The system offers templates for quick answers to FAQs or storing reusable snippets. A full review, installation guide, and team deployment setup are available at ToolGenix.
caption:
Can AI agents save $200/month on tokens? Context Mode claims yes.

Context Mode is an open-source MCP-based context management system. It doesn't compress tokens after they bloat your context — it prevents bloat before it starts.

Tested with 315KB Playwright snapshots, reduced to 5.4KB, a 98% reduction. This helps AI agent developers avoid evaporating their $200/month token budget.

The system offers templates for quick answers to FAQs or storing reusable snippets. A full review, installation guide, and team deployment setup are available at ToolGenix.

headline: TCL's $7,999.99 85-inch RGB-Mini LED TV revealed
summary: TCL's new RGB-Mini LED TV offers vibrant colors and brightness. The 85-inch model costs $7,999.99.
details: The TCL RM9L RGB-Mini LED TV comes in 85-inch, 98-inch, and 115-inch sizes, with prices starting at $7,999.99. The 85-inch model is typically discounted by $2,000, while the 98-inch model is usually $1,000 off.
The TV features four HDMI 2.1 ports, each supporting a 144Hz refresh rate for low latency PC gaming. It also has two USB ports, an Ethernet port, and a digital optical port.
The TV's picture quality was not as exceptional as expected, but tweaking settings improved performance. OLED models are still competitive, but cost around $2,700 or less.
The install process was straightforward, but maneuvering the large TV was challenging due to its size and weight. The remote is clean and easy to use, with a backlight and clever brightness controls.
caption:
Can a $7,999.99 TV deliver on its promises? TCL's new RGB-Mini LED TV is here.

The TCL RM9L RGB-Mini LED TV comes in 85-inch, 98-inch, and 115-inch sizes, with prices starting at $7,999.99. The 85-inch model is typically discounted by $2,000, while the 98-inch model is usually $1,000 off.

The TV features four HDMI 2.1 ports, each supporting a 144Hz refresh rate for low latency PC gaming. It also has two USB ports, an Ethernet port, and a digital optical port.

The TV's picture quality was not as exceptional as expected, but tweaking settings improved performance. OLED models are still competitive, but cost around $2,700 or less.

The install process was straightforward, but maneuvering the large TV was challenging due to its size and weight. The remote is clean and easy to use, with a backlight and clever brightness controls.
